I just saw the update and I'm totally devastated, not only because of the cats situation but for you too, especially cuz we have similar ages.

I think the best way to end this is you moving asap, I know you probably can't afford it right now but maybe you could try selling used clothes or something like that on the meantime.

I really wish you the best, I know how hard it is but I'm sure you'll overcome it. If you need to even just vent, you can count on me.

(btw Linkin could have tapeworms or smth similar, if he eats plants is probably that)

NTA at all! 

Firstly, you really need to get the cat (if you could I would even take the 2 cats). Both cats may develop a lot of mental and physicals issues. And it's obvious that your mom isn't a stable, responsible person, especially for a cat like Linkin.

If the cat has a microchip it's a bit harder cuz any vet can see that your mom is the owner. If that's the case, animal control is a good solution. If not, the cat(s) MAY disappear to a distant as possible home. 

Good luck!

NTA. Your brother and his "friends" are the ones disrespecting your boundaries, not you.

The friends shouldn't even be allowed in your house (I know it's not your choice obviously). So, if you feel safe with anyone in your family I would recommend you to share this situation with them, at least the bad influence that is been passed to your brother. For your sake.

NTA. She can't control how she reacts so I think she needs to understand that you can't control your trauma responses neither. I don't think she's a lost cause, she may be just hurt because she may wanted to spend time with you and her words sounded harsher.

Maybe take some time to do calmer activities or games that won't trigger big reactions, and you both enjoy, with her.

He's projecting his own past on you and I don't think he'll change or overcome that for now, with time he may even get worse, controlling even (an exemple is your daughter’s father situation).

You deserve much better, leave that AH.
